<h1 id="pipeline-options">Pipeline options</h1>
<p>Pipeline options allow to customize the execution of the models during the conversion pipeline.
This includes options for the OCR engines, the table model as well as enrichment options which
can be enabled with <code>do_xyz = True</code>.</p>
<p>This is an automatic generated API reference of the all the pipeline options available in Docling.</p>
<h2 id="latex-tikz-rendering">LaTeX TikZ Rendering</h2>
<p>Docling's LaTeX backend can optionally render <code>tikzpicture</code> environments into
images using the Tectonic engine.</p>
<h3 id="backend-options">Backend options</h3>
<p><code>LatexBackendOptions</code> supports the following TikZ-related options:</p>
<ul>
<li><code>tikz_engine</code>
  Set to <code>"tectonic"</code> to enable optional TikZ rendering.</li>
<li><code>tikz_engine_timeout</code>
  Sets the timeout, in seconds, for rendering a single TikZ diagram.</li>
<li><code>tikz_engine_allow_shell_escape</code>
  Defaults to <code>False</code>. Enable this only when required by the input document,
  since shell escape is less safe for untrusted LaTeX sources.</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="cli-flags">CLI flags</h3>
<p>The CLI exposes the same behavior with these flags:</p>
<ul>
<li><code>--tikz-engine</code> / <code>-T</code></li>
<li><code>--tikz-engine-timeout</code></li>
<li><code>--tikz-shell-escape</code></li>
</ul>
<h3 id="fallback-behavior">Fallback behavior</h3>
<ul>
<li>When Tectonic compilation succeeds, the TikZ diagram is rasterized and stored
  as an image.</li>
<li>When compilation fails, times out, produces no PDF, or rasterization fails,
  Docling preserves the original TikZ source as fallback code metadata instead
  of dropping the figure.</li>
</ul>

<div class="doc doc-object doc-attribute">



<h4 id="docling.datamodel.pipeline_options.AsrPipelineOptions.document_timeout" class="doc doc-heading">
<code class="doc-symbol doc-symbol-heading doc-symbol-attribute"></code>            <span class="doc doc-object-name doc-attribute-name">document_timeout</span>


  <span class="doc doc-labels">
      <small class="doc doc-label doc-label-pydantic-field"><code>pydantic-field</code></small>
  </span>

</h4>
<div class="doc-signature highlight"><pre><span></span><code><span class="n">document_timeout</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n"><span title="float">float</span></span> <span class="o">|</span> <span class="kc">None</span>
</code></pre></div>

    <div class="doc doc-contents ">

        <p>Maximum processing time in seconds before aborting document conversion. When exceeded, the pipeline stops processing and returns partial results with PARTIAL_SUCCESS status. Timeout errors are recorded in ConversionResult.errors with category=TIMEOUT and descriptive error messages. Use ConversionResult.has_timeout_errors() to detect timeouts. If None, no timeout is enforced. Recommended: 90-120 seconds for production systems.</p>

    </div>

</div>

<code class="doc-symbol doc-symbol-heading doc-symbol-class"></code>            <span class="doc doc-object-name doc-class-name">BaseLayoutOptions</span>

        <p>Base options for document layout analysis models.</p>
<p>Layout analysis detects the structural regions of a document page
(text blocks, tables, figures, headers, etc.) and assigns content
cells to those regions. This base class provides the shared controls
for empty-cluster retention and cell-assignment skipping.</p>

<h3 id="docling.datamodel.pipeline_options.BaseLayoutPostprocessorOptions" class="doc doc-heading">
<code class="doc-symbol doc-symbol-heading doc-symbol-class"></code>            <span class="doc doc-object-name doc-class-name">BaseLayoutPostprocessorOptions</span>


  <span class="doc doc-labels">
      <small class="doc doc-label doc-label-pydantic-model"><code>pydantic-model</code></small>
  </span>

</h3>


    <div class="doc doc-contents ">
            <p class="doc doc-class-bases">
              Bases: <code><a class="autorefs autorefs-internal" title="&lt;code class=&quot;doc-symbol doc-symbol-heading doc-symbol-class&quot;&gt;&lt;/code&gt;            &lt;span class=&quot;doc doc-object-name doc-class-name&quot;&gt;BaseOptions&lt;/span&gt;


  &lt;span class=&quot;doc doc-labels&quot;&gt;
      &lt;small class=&quot;doc doc-label doc-label-pydantic-model&quot;&gt;&lt;code&gt;pydantic-model&lt;/code&gt;&lt;/small&gt;
  &lt;/span&gt;" href="./#docling.datamodel.pipeline_options.BaseOptions">BaseOptions</a></code></p>

        <p>Algorithm parameters consumed by <code>LayoutPostprocessor</code>.</p>
<p>These controls drive the post-processing of raw layout clusters
(cell assignment, empty-cluster handling, orphan-cluster creation).
They are decoupled from the layout (prediction) options so the
post-processing stage and the predictor models can evolve
independently.</p>

<h3 id="docling.datamodel.pipeline_options.BaseOptions" class="doc doc-heading">
<code class="doc-symbol doc-symbol-heading doc-symbol-class"></code>            <span class="doc doc-object-name doc-class-name">BaseOptions</span>


  <span class="doc doc-labels">
      <small class="doc doc-label doc-label-pydantic-model"><code>pydantic-model</code></small>
  </span>

</h3>


    <div class="doc doc-contents ">
            <p class="doc doc-class-bases">
              Bases: <code><span title="pydantic.BaseModel">BaseModel</span></code></p>

        <p>Base class for all pipeline option models.</p>
<p>Every option class in the pipeline configuration hierarchy inherits from
<code>BaseOptions</code>. Subclasses must declare a <code>kind</code> ClassVar that serves as
a discriminator for polymorphic deserialization in Pydantic unions.</p>


<p><span class="doc-section-title">Attributes:</span></p>
    <ul>
        <li class="doc-section-item field-body">
          <b><code><a class="autorefs autorefs-internal" title="&lt;code class=&quot;doc-symbol doc-symbol-heading doc-symbol-attribute&quot;&gt;&lt;/code&gt;            &lt;span class=&quot;doc doc-object-name doc-attribute-name&quot;&gt;kind&lt;/span&gt;


  &lt;span class=&quot;doc doc-labels&quot;&gt;
      &lt;small class=&quot;doc doc-label doc-label-class-attribute&quot;&gt;&lt;code&gt;class-attribute&lt;/code&gt;&lt;/small&gt;
  &lt;/span&gt;" href="./#docling.datamodel.pipeline_options.BaseOptions.kind">kind</a></code></b>
              (<code><span title="str">str</span></code>)
          –
          <div class="doc-md-description">
            <p>String discriminator identifying the concrete option type.
Must be declared as a <code>ClassVar[str]</code> or
<code>ClassVar[Literal[...]]</code> in each subclass.</p>
          </div>
        </li>
    </ul>

      <details><summary>Show JSON schema:</summary>

</h3>


    <div class="doc doc-contents ">
            <p class="doc doc-class-bases">
              Bases: <code><a class="autorefs autorefs-internal" title="&lt;code class=&quot;doc-symbol doc-symbol-heading doc-symbol-class&quot;&gt;&lt;/code&gt;            &lt;span class=&quot;doc doc-object-name doc-class-name&quot;&gt;PipelineOptions&lt;/span&gt;


  &lt;span class=&quot;doc doc-labels&quot;&gt;
      &lt;small class=&quot;doc doc-label doc-label-pydantic-model&quot;&gt;&lt;code&gt;pydantic-model&lt;/code&gt;&lt;/small&gt;
  &lt;/span&gt;" href="./#docling.datamodel.pipeline_options.PipelineOptions">PipelineOptions</a></code></p>

        <p>Base configuration for document conversion pipelines.</p>
<p>Extends <code>PipelineOptions</code> with picture-related features: classification
(categorizing images by type) and description (generating textual
captions via vision-language models). Also supports chart data extraction
from bar, pie, and line charts.</p>

<h4 id="docling.datamodel.pipeline_options.ConvertPipelineOptions.document_timeout" class="doc doc-heading">
<code class="doc-symbol doc-symbol-heading doc-symbol-attribute"></code>            <span class="doc doc-object-name doc-attribute-name">document_timeout</span>


  <span class="doc doc-labels">
      <small class="doc doc-label doc-label-pydantic-field"><code>pydantic-field</code></small>
  </span>

</h4>
<div class="doc-signature highlight"><pre><span></span><code><span class="n">document_timeout</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n"><span title="float">float</span></span> <span class="o">|</span> <span class="kc">None</span>
</code></pre></div>

    <div class="doc doc-contents ">

        <p>Maximum processing time in seconds before aborting document conversion. When exceeded, the pipeline stops processing and returns partial results with PARTIAL_SUCCESS status. Timeout errors are recorded in ConversionResult.errors with category=TIMEOUT and descriptive error messages. Use ConversionResult.has_timeout_errors() to detect timeouts. If None, no timeout is enforced. Recommended: 90-120 seconds for production systems.</p>

    </div>

</div>

        <p>Configuration for picture description model. Uses new preset system (recommended). Default: 'smolvlm' preset. Only applicable when <code>do_picture_description=True</code>. Example: PictureDescriptionVlmOptions.from_preset('granite_vision')</p>

<h4 id="docling.datamodel.pipeline_options.EasyOcrOptions.lang" class="doc doc-heading">
<code class="doc-symbol doc-symbol-heading doc-symbol-attribute"></code>            <span class="doc doc-object-name doc-attribute-name">lang</span>


  <span class="doc doc-labels">
      <small class="doc doc-label doc-label-pydantic-field"><code>pydantic-field</code></small>
  </span>

</h4>
<div class="doc-signature highlight"><pre><span></span><code><span class="n">lang</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n"><span title="list">list</span></span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n"><span title="str">str</span></span><span class="p">]</span>
</code></pre></div>

    <div class="doc doc-contents ">

        <p>OCR languages, written as EasyOCR's own codes (<code>en</code>, <code>ch_sim</code>, <code>ang</code>) or as BCP-47 tags behind the <code>iso:</code> prefix. EasyOCR covers 80+ languages and runs several at once, but they must share a recognition model, so keep the list short and script-consistent. Each language is routed to the recognition network of its script, so <code>ru</code> reaches the Cyrillic model. EasyOCR has no multilingual model -- list the languages explicitly.</p>

    </div>

</div>

<div class="doc doc-object doc-class">



<h3 id="docling.datamodel.pipeline_options.HeadingHierarchyOptions" class="doc doc-heading">
<code class="doc-symbol doc-symbol-heading doc-symbol-class"></code>            <span class="doc doc-object-name doc-class-name">HeadingHierarchyOptions</span>


  <span class="doc doc-labels">
      <small class="doc doc-label doc-label-pydantic-model"><code>pydantic-model</code></small>
  </span>

</h3>


    <div class="doc doc-contents ">
            <p class="doc doc-class-bases">
              Bases: <code><span title="pydantic.BaseModel">BaseModel</span></code></p>

        <p>Options for inferring section-header levels in the PDF/image pipeline.</p>
<p>The layout model only flags regions as <code>SECTION_HEADER</code> without a level, so every
heading produced by the PDF path defaults to <code>level=1</code> and the document hierarchy is
flattened. When <code>enabled</code>, :class:<code>HeadingHierarchyModel</code> runs right after the
reading-order model and assigns <code>SectionHeaderItem.level</code> from (in precedence order)
PDF bookmarks/ToC, numbering and font style. The step changes heading levels and may
promote a heading mis-classified as a list-item when it confidently matches a bookmark;
otherwise it never adds, removes or reorders items, and headings for which no signal
applies keep their current level.</p>


<details class="notes" open>
  <summary>Notes</summary>
  <ul>
<li><code>use_bookmarks</code> reads the PDF outline surfaced on <code>ConversionResult._pdf_outline</code>.
  When a bookmark confidently matches a detected heading it is authoritative; entries
  that match nothing fall back to numbering/style, so partial/noisy outlines never
  degrade the numbering result.</li>
<li><code>use_style</code> requires the parsed PDF cells to still be available when the
  heading-hierarchy step runs, i.e.
  <code>PdfPipelineOptions.generate_parsed_pages=True</code>. Without them, style inference is
  silently skipped (numbering still applies).</li>
</ul>
</details>
      <details><summary>Show JSON schema:</summary>
        <div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><code><span class="p">{</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nt">"description"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"Options for inferring section-header levels in the PDF/image pipeline.\n\nThe layout model only flags regions as ``SECTION_HEADER`` without a level, so every\nheading produced by the PDF path defaults to ``level=1`` and the document hierarchy is\nflattened. When ``enabled``, :class:`HeadingHierarchyModel` runs right after the\nreading-order model and assigns ``SectionHeaderItem.level`` from (in precedence order)\nPDF bookmarks/ToC, numbering and font style. The step changes heading levels and may\npromote a heading mis-classified as a list-item when it confidently matches a bookmark;\notherwise it never adds, removes or reorders items, and headings for which no signal\napplies keep their current level.\n\nNotes:\n    - ``use_bookmarks`` reads the PDF outline surfaced on ``ConversionResult._pdf_outline``.\n      When a bookmark confidently matches a detected heading it is authoritative; entries\n      that match nothing fall back to numbering/style, so partial/noisy outlines never\n      degrade the numbering result.\n    - ``use_style`` requires the parsed PDF cells to still be available when the\n      heading-hierarchy step runs, i.e.\n      ``PdfPipelineOptions.generate_parsed_pages=True``. Without them, style inference is\n      silently skipped (numbering still applies)."</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nt">"properties"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="nt">"enabled"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span>
<span class="w">      </span><span class="nt">"default"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">false</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="w">      </span><span class="nt">"description"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"Enable inference of section-header levels for the PDF/image pipeline. When disabled (default), all detected headings remain at level 1 (unchanged behavior)."</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="w">      </span><span class="nt">"title"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"Enabled"</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="w">      </span><span class="nt">"type"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"boolean"</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">},</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="nt">"use_bookmarks"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span>
<span class="w">      </span><span class="nt">"default"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">true</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="w">      </span><span class="nt">"description"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"Use the PDF bookmarks / table-of-contents (when present) as the authoritative heading signal. Bookmarks are fuzzily matched to detected headings by title and page; confident matches win over numbering and style, and a confidently matched list-item is promoted to a heading. Unmatched entries fall back to numbering/style."</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="w">      </span><span class="nt">"title"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"Use Bookmarks"</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="w">      </span><span class="nt">"type"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"boolean"</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">},</span>

<span class="w">      </span><span class="nt">"default"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">true</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="w">      </span><span class="nt">"description"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"Use legal/outline numbering (e.g. PART I -&gt; 1. -&gt; 1.1 -&gt; (a) -&gt; (i), Roman vs Arabic numerals) as the primary signal for headings without a bookmark match."</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="w">      </span><span class="nt">"title"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"Use Numbering"</span><span class="p">,</span>

<span class="w">      </span><span class="nt">"description"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"Use the visual style of the heading (font size, and with `use_font_style` also weight, slant and letter case) as a fallback for headings without recognizable numbering. Requires `generate_parsed_pages=True`."</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="w">      </span><span class="nt">"title"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"Use Style"</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="w">      </span><span class="nt">"type"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"boolean"</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">},</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="nt">"use_font_style"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span>
<span class="w">      </span><span class="nt">"default"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">true</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="w">      </span><span class="nt">"description"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"Refine the style fallback with the font weight and slant read from the embedded PDF font names, plus all-caps detection, so that headings sharing a font size are still ranked (bold above regular, upright above italic, all-caps above mixed case). Ignored when `use_style` is disabled; font names that carry no recognizable styling fall back to font size alone."</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="w">      </span><span class="nt">"title"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"Use Font Style"</span><span class="p">,</span>

<div class="doc doc-object doc-attribute">



<h4 id="docling.datamodel.pipeline_options.HeadingHierarchyOptions.bookmark_match_threshold" class="doc doc-heading">
<code class="doc-symbol doc-symbol-heading doc-symbol-attribute"></code>            <span class="doc doc-object-name doc-attribute-name">bookmark_match_threshold</span>


  <span class="doc doc-labels">
      <small class="doc doc-label doc-label-pydantic-field"><code>pydantic-field</code></small>
  </span>

</h4>
<div class="doc-signature highlight"><pre><span></span><code><span class="n">bookmark_match_threshold</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n"><span title="float">float</span></span>
</code></pre></div>

    <div class="doc doc-contents ">

        <p>Minimum normalized title-similarity (0..1) for a bookmark to be considered a match to a detected heading/list-item. Below this, the bookmark is ignored and the heading falls back to numbering/style. Higher = stricter.</p>

    </div>

</div>

<div class="doc doc-object doc-attribute">



<h4 id="docling.datamodel.pipeline_options.HeadingHierarchyOptions.enabled" class="doc doc-heading">
<code class="doc-symbol doc-symbol-heading doc-symbol-attribute"></code>            <span class="doc doc-object-name doc-attribute-name">enabled</span>


  <span class="doc doc-labels">
      <small class="doc doc-label doc-label-pydantic-field"><code>pydantic-field</code></small>
  </span>

</h4>
<div class="doc-signature highlight"><pre><span></span><code><span class="n">enabled</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n"><span title="bool">bool</span></span>
</code></pre></div>

    <div class="doc doc-contents ">

        <p>Enable inference of section-header levels for the PDF/image pipeline. When disabled (default), all detected headings remain at level 1 (unchanged behavior).</p>

    </div>

</div>

<div class="doc doc-object doc-attribute">



<h4 id="docling.datamodel.pipeline_options.HeadingHierarchyOptions.max_level" class="doc doc-heading">
<code class="doc-symbol doc-symbol-heading doc-symbol-attribute"></code>            <span class="doc doc-object-name doc-attribute-name">max_level</span>


  <span class="doc doc-labels">
      <small class="doc doc-label doc-label-pydantic-field"><code>pydantic-field</code></small>
  </span>

</h4>
<div class="doc-signature highlight"><pre><span></span><code><span class="n">max_level</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n"><span title="int">int</span></span>
</code></pre></div>

    <div class="doc doc-contents ">

        <p>Maximum heading level to assign. Deeper levels are clamped.</p>

    </div>

</div>

<div class="doc doc-object doc-attribute">



<h4 id="docling.datamodel.pipeline_options.HeadingHierarchyOptions.numbering_schemes" class="doc doc-heading">
<code class="doc-symbol doc-symbol-heading doc-symbol-attribute"></code>            <span class="doc doc-object-name doc-attribute-name">numbering_schemes</span>


  <span class="doc doc-labels">
      <small class="doc doc-label doc-label-pydantic-field"><code>pydantic-field</code></small>
  </span>

</h4>
<div class="doc-signature highlight"><pre><span></span><code><span class="n">numbering_schemes</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n"><span title="list">list</span></span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n"><span title="str">str</span></span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">|</span> <span class="kc">None</span>
</code></pre></div>

    <div class="doc doc-contents ">

        <p>Optional override of the numbering-scheme precedence (highest level first). Known schemes: 'part', 'chapter', 'article', 'roman_u', 'arabic', 'alpha_u', 'alpha_l', 'roman_l'. When None, a default legal/regulatory ordering is used.</p>

    </div>

</div>

<div class="doc doc-object doc-attribute">



<h4 id="docling.datamodel.pipeline_options.HeadingHierarchyOptions.style_size_tolerance" class="doc doc-heading">
<code class="doc-symbol doc-symbol-heading doc-symbol-attribute"></code>            <span class="doc doc-object-name doc-attribute-name">style_size_tolerance</span>


  <span class="doc doc-labels">
      <small class="doc doc-label doc-label-pydantic-field"><code>pydantic-field</code></small>
  </span>

</h4>
<div class="doc-signature highlight"><pre><span></span><code><span class="n">style_size_tolerance</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n"><span title="float">float</span></span>
</code></pre></div>

    <div class="doc doc-contents ">

        <p>Relative difference below which two heading font sizes are treated as one size by the style fallback. The size of a heading is measured from its cells, so the same font measures a little taller on a heading that has descenders; without this tolerance such headings would land on different levels. Higher = more sizes collapse into one level.</p>

    </div>

</div>

<div class="doc doc-object doc-attribute">



<h4 id="docling.datamodel.pipeline_options.HeadingHierarchyOptions.use_bookmarks" class="doc doc-heading">
<code class="doc-symbol doc-symbol-heading doc-symbol-attribute"></code>            <span class="doc doc-object-name doc-attribute-name">use_bookmarks</span>


  <span class="doc doc-labels">
      <small class="doc doc-label doc-label-pydantic-field"><code>pydantic-field</code></small>
  </span>

</h4>
<div class="doc-signature highlight"><pre><span></span><code><span class="n">use_bookmarks</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n"><span title="bool">bool</span></span>
</code></pre></div>

    <div class="doc doc-contents ">

        <p>Use the PDF bookmarks / table-of-contents (when present) as the authoritative heading signal. Bookmarks are fuzzily matched to detected headings by title and page; confident matches win over numbering and style, and a confidently matched list-item is promoted to a heading. Unmatched entries fall back to numbering/style.</p>

    </div>

</div>

<div class="doc doc-object doc-attribute">



<h4 id="docling.datamodel.pipeline_options.HeadingHierarchyOptions.use_font_style" class="doc doc-heading">
<code class="doc-symbol doc-symbol-heading doc-symbol-attribute"></code>            <span class="doc doc-object-name doc-attribute-name">use_font_style</span>


  <span class="doc doc-labels">
      <small class="doc doc-label doc-label-pydantic-field"><code>pydantic-field</code></small>
  </span>

</h4>
<div class="doc-signature highlight"><pre><span></span><code><span class="n">use_font_style</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n"><span title="bool">bool</span></span>
</code></pre></div>

    <div class="doc doc-contents ">

        <p>Refine the style fallback with the font weight and slant read from the embedded PDF font names, plus all-caps detection, so that headings sharing a font size are still ranked (bold above regular, upright above italic, all-caps above mixed case). Ignored when <code>use_style</code> is disabled; font names that carry no recognizable styling fall back to font size alone.</p>

    </div>

</div>

<div class="doc doc-object doc-attribute">



<h4 id="docling.datamodel.pipeline_options.HeadingHierarchyOptions.use_numbering" class="doc doc-heading">
<code class="doc-symbol doc-symbol-heading doc-symbol-attribute"></code>            <span class="doc doc-object-name doc-attribute-name">use_numbering</span>


  <span class="doc doc-labels">
      <small class="doc doc-label doc-label-pydantic-field"><code>pydantic-field</code></small>
  </span>

</h4>
<div class="doc-signature highlight"><pre><span></span><code><span class="n">use_numbering</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n"><span title="bool">bool</span></span>
</code></pre></div>

    <div class="doc doc-contents ">

        <p>Use legal/outline numbering (e.g. PART I -&gt; 1. -&gt; 1.1 -&gt; (a) -&gt; (i), Roman vs Arabic numerals) as the primary signal for headings without a bookmark match.</p>

    </div>

</div>

<div class="doc doc-object doc-attribute">



<h4 id="docling.datamodel.pipeline_options.HeadingHierarchyOptions.use_style" class="doc doc-heading">
<code class="doc-symbol doc-symbol-heading doc-symbol-attribute"></code>            <span class="doc doc-object-name doc-attribute-name">use_style</span>


  <span class="doc doc-labels">
      <small class="doc doc-label doc-label-pydantic-field"><code>pydantic-field</code></small>
  </span>

</h4>
<div class="doc-signature highlight"><pre><span></span><code><span class="n">use_style</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n"><span title="bool">bool</span></span>
</code></pre></div>

    <div class="doc doc-contents ">

        <p>Use the visual style of the heading (font size, and with <code>use_font_style</code> also weight, slant and letter case) as a fallback for headings without recognizable numbering. Requires <code>generate_parsed_pages=True</code>.</p>

    </div>

</div>






  </div>

    </div>

<div class="doc doc-object doc-class">



<h3 id="docling.datamodel.pipeline_options.KserveV2OcrOptions" class="doc doc-heading">
<code class="doc-symbol doc-symbol-heading doc-symbol-class"></code>            <span class="doc doc-object-name doc-class-name">KserveV2OcrOptions</span>


  <span class="doc doc-labels">
      <small class="doc doc-label doc-label-pydantic-model"><code>pydantic-model</code></small>
  </span>

</h3>


    <div class="doc doc-contents ">
            <p class="doc doc-class-bases">
              Bases: <code><a class="autorefs autorefs-internal" title="&lt;code class=&quot;doc-symbol doc-symbol-heading doc-symbol-class&quot;&gt;&lt;/code&gt;            &lt;span class=&quot;doc doc-object-name doc-class-name&quot;&gt;OcrOptions&lt;/span&gt;


  &lt;span class=&quot;doc doc-labels&quot;&gt;
      &lt;small class=&quot;doc doc-label doc-label-pydantic-model&quot;&gt;&lt;code&gt;pydantic-model&lt;/code&gt;&lt;/small&gt;
  &lt;/span&gt;" href="./#docling.datamodel.pipeline_options.OcrOptions">OcrOptions</a></code>, <code><span title="docling.datamodel.kserve_v2_options.KserveV2OptionsMixin">KserveV2OptionsMixin</span></code></p>

        <p>Configuration for KServe v2-based OCR (e.g., Triton Inference Server).</p>
<p>This OCR engine connects to a remote KServe v2-compatible inference server
(such as Triton) to perform OCR via gRPC or HTTP. It combines standard OCR
options with KServe v2 connection settings inherited from KserveV2OptionsMixin.</p>
<p>The engine handles custom preprocessing (RGB conversion, transpose, batching)
to match the expected input format of typical OCR models deployed on KServe v2
endpoints.</p>


<details class="see-also" open>
  <summary>See Also</summary>
  <p><code>KserveV2OptionsMixin</code>: Provides all KServe v2 connection configuration.
<code>RapidOcrOptions</code>: Local OCR engine for comparison.</p>
</details>

<h3 id="docling.datamodel.pipeline_options.LayoutObjectDetectionOptions" class="doc doc-heading">
<code class="doc-symbol doc-symbol-heading doc-symbol-class"></code>            <span class="doc doc-object-name doc-class-name">LayoutObjectDetectionOptions</span>


  <span class="doc doc-labels">

</h3>


    <div class="doc doc-contents ">
            <p class="doc doc-class-bases">
              Bases: <code><span title="docling.datamodel.stage_model_specs.ObjectDetectionStagePresetMixin">ObjectDetectionStagePresetMixin</span></code>, <code><span title="docling.models.inference_engines.object_detection.base.ObjectDetectionEngineOptionsMixin">ObjectDetectionEngineOptionsMixin</span></code>, <code><a class="autorefs autorefs-internal" title="&lt;code class=&quot;doc-symbol doc-symbol-heading doc-symbol-class&quot;&gt;&lt;/code&gt;            &lt;span class=&quot;doc doc-object-name doc-class-name&quot;&gt;BaseLayoutOptions&lt;/span&gt;


  &lt;span class=&quot;doc doc-labels&quot;&gt;
      &lt;small class=&quot;doc doc-label doc-label-pydantic-model&quot;&gt;&lt;code&gt;pydantic-model&lt;/code&gt;&lt;/small&gt;
  &lt;/span&gt;" href="./#docling.datamodel.pipeline_options.BaseLayoutOptions">BaseLayoutOptions</a></code></p>

        <p>Options for layout detection using object-detection runtimes.</p>
<p>The default layout options. Uses the pluggable object-detection engine
system with preset support via <code>ObjectDetectionStagePresetMixin</code>; use
<code>from_preset()</code> to create instances from registered model presets.</p>


<details class="notes" open>
  <summary>Notes</summary>
  <p>The default model is <code>layout_heron_default</code>. For higher accuracy on
complex documents, consider the <code>layout_egret_large</code> or
<code>layout_egret_xlarge</code> presets.</p>
</details>

<details class="example" open>
  <summary>Example</summary>
  <blockquote>
<blockquote>
<blockquote>
<p>LayoutObjectDetectionOptions.from_preset("layout_egret_large")</p>
</blockquote>
</blockquote>
</blockquote>

<div class="doc doc-object doc-class">



<h3 id="docling.datamodel.pipeline_options.LayoutOptions" class="doc doc-heading">
<code class="doc-symbol doc-symbol-heading doc-symbol-class"></code>            <span class="doc doc-object-name doc-class-name">LayoutOptions</span>


  <span class="doc doc-labels">
      <small class="doc doc-label doc-label-pydantic-model"><code>pydantic-model</code></small>
  </span>

</h3>


    <div class="doc doc-contents ">
            <p class="doc doc-class-bases">
              Bases: <code><a class="autorefs autorefs-internal" title="&lt;code class=&quot;doc-symbol doc-symbol-heading doc-symbol-class&quot;&gt;&lt;/code&gt;            &lt;span class=&quot;doc doc-object-name doc-class-name&quot;&gt;BaseLayoutOptions&lt;/span&gt;


  &lt;span class=&quot;doc doc-labels&quot;&gt;
      &lt;small class=&quot;doc doc-label doc-label-pydantic-model&quot;&gt;&lt;code&gt;pydantic-model&lt;/code&gt;&lt;/small&gt;
  &lt;/span&gt;" href="./#docling.datamodel.pipeline_options.BaseLayoutOptions">BaseLayoutOptions</a></code></p>

        <p>Deprecated. Use <code>LayoutObjectDetectionOptions</code> instead.</p>
<p>Retained so existing code keeps working: it still constructs, still
selects any of the supported layout models, and is translated onto
<code>LayoutObjectDetectionOptions</code> by the <code>LayoutModel</code> shim.</p>


<details class="notes" open>
  <summary>Notes</summary>
  <p><code>DOCLING_LAYOUT_V2</code> is no longer supported and falls back to
<code>DOCLING_LAYOUT_HERON</code> with a warning.</p>
<p>Removing this class also retires <code>layout_model_specs</code> (including every
<code>DOCLING_LAYOUT_*</code> constant and <code>LayoutModelConfig</code>) and the
<code>models/stages/layout/layout_model.py</code> shim, which exist solely to
serve it.</p>
</details>

<details class="example" open>
  <summary>Example</summary>
  <blockquote>
<blockquote>
<blockquote>
<p>LayoutObjectDetectionOptions.from_preset("layout_heron_default")</p>
</blockquote>
</blockquote>
</blockquote>
</details>

</code></pre></div>

    <div class="doc doc-contents ">

        <p>Create clusters for orphaned elements not assigned to any structure. When True, isolated text or elements are grouped into their own clusters. Recommended for complete document coverage.</p>

    </div>

</code></pre></div>

    <div class="doc doc-contents ">

<code>run_postprocessor</code>. When disabled, the stage only computes the
layout confidence score and leaves the raw clusters untouched
(used by the table-crops layout model).</p>

<h3 id="docling.datamodel.pipeline_options.NativePdfPipelineOptions" class="doc doc-heading">
<code class="doc-symbol doc-symbol-heading doc-symbol-class"></code>            <span class="doc doc-object-name doc-class-name">NativePdfPipelineOptions</span>


  <span class="doc doc-labels">
      <small class="doc doc-label doc-label-pydantic-model"><code>pydantic-model</code></small>
  </span>

</h3>


    <div class="doc doc-contents ">
            <p class="doc doc-class-bases">
              Bases: <code><a class="autorefs autorefs-internal" title="&lt;code class=&quot;doc-symbol doc-symbol-heading doc-symbol-class&quot;&gt;&lt;/code&gt;            &lt;span class=&quot;doc doc-object-name doc-class-name&quot;&gt;PaginatedPipelineOptions&lt;/span&gt;


  &lt;span class=&quot;doc doc-labels&quot;&gt;
      &lt;small class=&quot;doc doc-label doc-label-pydantic-model&quot;&gt;&lt;code&gt;pydantic-model&lt;/code&gt;&lt;/small&gt;
  &lt;/span&gt;" href="./#docling.datamodel.pipeline_options.PaginatedPipelineOptions">PaginatedPipelineOptions</a></code></p>

        <p>Pipeline options for the native (model-free) PDF pipeline.</p>
<p>The native pipeline reads what is already encoded in the PDF: the text cells
and the embedded bitmap images reported by docling-parse. It runs no layout,
OCR or table-structure model, so conversion is fast but the resulting
<code>DoclingDocument</code> carries one plain <code>TextItem</code> per text cell in the parser's
order, without reading order, headings or tables.</p>


<details class="note" open>
  <summary>Note</summary>
  <p>Native picture images additionally require the PDF backend to decode the
embedded bitmaps (<code>PdfBackendOptions.include_bitmap_images=True</code>);
without it, pictures are still emitted, but only with their bounding box.</p>
</details>

<details class="see-also" open>
  <summary>See Also</summary>
  <p><code>PdfPipelineOptions</code>: Full PDF pipeline with layout, OCR and tables.</p>
</details>

<h4 id="docling.datamodel.pipeline_options.NativePdfPipelineOptions.document_timeout" class="doc doc-heading">
<code class="doc-symbol doc-symbol-heading doc-symbol-attribute"></code>            <span class="doc doc-object-name doc-attribute-name">document_timeout</span>


  <span class="doc doc-labels">
      <small class="doc doc-label doc-label-pydantic-field"><code>pydantic-field</code></small>
  </span>

</h4>
<div class="doc-signature highlight"><pre><span></span><code><span class="n">document_timeout</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n"><span title="float">float</span></span> <span class="o">|</span> <span class="kc">None</span>
</code></pre></div>

    <div class="doc doc-contents ">

        <p>Maximum processing time in seconds before aborting document conversion. When exceeded, the pipeline stops processing and returns partial results with PARTIAL_SUCCESS status. Timeout errors are recorded in ConversionResult.errors with category=TIMEOUT and descriptive error messages. Use ConversionResult.has_timeout_errors() to detect timeouts. If None, no timeout is enforced. Recommended: 90-120 seconds for production systems.</p>

    </div>

</div>

<h4 id="docling.datamodel.pipeline_options.NemotronOcrOptions.lang" class="doc doc-heading">
<code class="doc-symbol doc-symbol-heading doc-symbol-attribute"></code>            <span class="doc doc-object-name doc-attribute-name">lang</span>


  <span class="doc doc-labels">
      <small class="doc doc-label doc-label-pydantic-field"><code>pydantic-field</code></small>
  </span>

</h4>
<div class="doc-signature highlight"><pre><span></span><code><span class="n">lang</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n"><span title="list">list</span></span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n"><span title="str">str</span></span><span class="p">]</span>
</code></pre></div>

    <div class="doc doc-contents ">

        <p>Recognition language, written as one of nemotron-OCR's own codes (<code>english</code>, <code>multilingual</code>) or as a BCP-47 tag behind the <code>iso:</code> prefix. nemotron-OCR-v2 ships two recognizers: <code>english</code>, <code>iso:en</code> and an empty list all select the English model, while <code>multilingual</code> and the languages that model covers (<code>iso:zh-Hans</code>, <code>iso:zh-Hant</code>, <code>iso:ja</code>, <code>iso:ko</code>, <code>iso:ru</code>) select the multilingual one. Any other Latin-script language whose alphabet the English recognizer can spell (<code>iso:de</code>, <code>iso:fr</code>, <code>iso:pl</code>, <code>iso:sr-Latn</code>, ...) is routed to the English model as a best effort, with a warning: NVIDIA validates none of them. A language that model cannot spell raises</p>

    </div>

</div>

<div class="doc doc-object doc-attribute">

</code></pre></div>

        <p>Granularity requested from Nemotron OCR. <code>sentence</code> is the default because it maps most directly to Docling OCR cells.</p>

<div class="doc doc-object doc-class">



<h3 id="docling.datamodel.pipeline_options.OcrAutoOptions" class="doc doc-heading">
<code class="doc-symbol doc-symbol-heading doc-symbol-class"></code>            <span class="doc doc-object-name doc-class-name">OcrAutoOptions</span>


  <span class="doc doc-labels">
      <small class="doc doc-label doc-label-pydantic-model"><code>pydantic-model</code></small>
  </span>

</h3>


    <div class="doc doc-contents ">
            <p class="doc doc-class-bases">
              Bases: <code><a class="autorefs autorefs-internal" title="&lt;code class=&quot;doc-symbol doc-symbol-heading doc-symbol-class&quot;&gt;&lt;/code&gt;            &lt;span class=&quot;doc doc-object-name doc-class-name&quot;&gt;OcrOptions&lt;/span&gt;


  &lt;span class=&quot;doc doc-labels&quot;&gt;
      &lt;small class=&quot;doc doc-label doc-label-pydantic-model&quot;&gt;&lt;code&gt;pydantic-model&lt;/code&gt;&lt;/small&gt;
  &lt;/span&gt;" href="./#docling.datamodel.pipeline_options.OcrOptions">OcrOptions</a></code></p>

        <p>Automatic OCR engine selection based on system availability.</p>
<p>When this option is used, Docling probes the runtime environment at
pipeline initialization and selects the best available OCR engine
(e.g., EasyOCR if GPU is present, Tesseract otherwise). The requested
languages are forwarded to whichever engine is chosen, and an engine with
no model for them is skipped in favour of the next candidate.</p>


<details class="notes" open>
  <summary>Notes</summary>
  <p><code>lang</code> is forwarded to whichever engine is selected. The default empty
list means "each engine's own default model", so leaving it alone
reproduces the behaviour of picking that engine by hand. An engine that
cannot serve the requested language is treated as unavailable and the
next candidate is probed.</p>
</details>

<h4 id="docling.datamodel.pipeline_options.OcrAutoOptions.lang" class="doc doc-heading">
<code class="doc-symbol doc-symbol-heading doc-symbol-attribute"></code>            <span class="doc doc-object-name doc-attribute-name">lang</span>


  <span class="doc doc-labels">
      <small class="doc doc-label doc-label-pydantic-field"><code>pydantic-field</code></small>
  </span>

</h4>
<div class="doc-signature highlight"><pre><span></span><code><span class="n">lang</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n"><span title="list">list</span></span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n"><span title="str">str</span></span><span class="p">]</span>
</code></pre></div>

    <div class="doc doc-contents ">

        <p>OCR languages forwarded to the automatically selected engine. A bare code is the engine's own, so with no engine picked yet prefer a BCP-47 tag behind the <code>iso:</code> prefix. The default empty list leaves the choice of model to that engine. Engines with no model for the requested language are skipped during selection.</p>

    </div>

<code class="doc-symbol doc-symbol-heading doc-symbol-attribute"></code>            <span class="doc doc-object-name doc-attribute-name">scale</span>

<h3 id="docling.datamodel.pipeline_options.OcrEngine" class="doc doc-heading">

              Bases: <code><span title="str">str</span></code>, <code><span title="enum.Enum">Enum</span></code></p>

<p>Each engine has different characteristics in terms of accuracy, speed, language support,
and platform compatibility. Choose based on your specific requirements.</p>

<h4 id="docling.datamodel.pipeline_options.OcrMacOptions.lang" class="doc doc-heading">
<code class="doc-symbol doc-symbol-heading doc-symbol-attribute"></code>            <span class="doc doc-object-name doc-attribute-name">lang</span>

<div class="doc-signature highlight"><pre><span></span><code><span class="n">lang</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n"><span title="list">list</span></span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n"><span title="str">str</span></span><span class="p">]</span>
</code></pre></div>

    <div class="doc doc-contents ">

        <p>OCR languages, written as the recognition languages the running macOS reports (<code>en-US</code>, <code>zh-Hans</code>) or as BCP-47 tags behind the <code>iso:</code> prefix, which are matched against them (<code>iso:de</code> becomes <code>de-DE</code>, <code>iso:pt</code> becomes <code>pt-BR</code>). An empty list hands the choice to Vision's own automatic behaviour.</p>

    </div>

<h3 id="docling.datamodel.pipeline_options.OcrMode" class="doc doc-heading">

            <p class="doc doc-class-bases">
              Bases: <code><a class="autorefs autorefs-internal" title="&lt;code class=&quot;doc-symbol doc-symbol-heading doc-symbol-class&quot;&gt;&lt;/code&gt;            &lt;span class=&quot;doc doc-object-name doc-class-name&quot;&gt;BaseOptions&lt;/span&gt;


  &lt;span class=&quot;doc doc-labels&quot;&gt;
      &lt;small class=&quot;doc doc-label doc-label-pydantic-model&quot;&gt;&lt;code&gt;pydantic-model&lt;/code&gt;&lt;/small&gt;
  &lt;/span&gt;" href="./#docling.datamodel.pipeline_options.BaseOptions">BaseOptions</a></code></p>

        <p>Base configuration for Optical Character Recognition engines.</p>
<p>Defines the common interface shared by all OCR engine implementations.
Subclasses provide engine-specific parameters while inheriting the shared
language selection, full-page OCR toggle, and bitmap area threshold.</p>


<details class="see-also" open>
  <summary>See Also</summary>
  <p><code>OcrAutoOptions</code>: Automatic engine selection based on availability.
<code>EasyOcrOptions</code>, <code>TesseractCliOcrOptions</code>, <code>TesseractOcrOptions</code>,
<code>RapidOcrOptions</code>, <code>OcrMacOptions</code>, <code>NemotronOcrOptions</code>: Engine-specific
configurations.</p>
</details>

<h4 id="docling.datamodel.pipeline_options.OcrOptions.scale" class="doc doc-heading">
<code class="doc-symbol doc-symbol-heading doc-symbol-attribute"></code>            <span class="doc doc-object-name doc-attribute-name">scale</span>


  <span class="doc doc-labels">
      <small class="doc doc-label doc-label-pydantic-field"><code>pydantic-field</code></small>
  </span>

</h4>
<div class="doc-signature highlight"><pre><span></span><code><span class="n">scale</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n"><span title="float">float</span></span>
</code></pre></div>

    <div class="doc doc-contents ">

        <p>Image scale multiplier applied before running OCR. The page is rendered at 72 DPI times this factor, so the default 3 yields 216 DPI. Lower it when the source image is already high resolution and upscaling degrades recognition.</p>

        <p>Configuration for pipelines processing paginated documents.</p>
<p>Extends <code>ConvertPipelineOptions</code> with page-level image generation
controls for formats that have a concept of discrete pages (PDF, PPTX,
images). Controls the resolution scaling and whether page/picture images
are generated during conversion.</p>

<div class="doc doc-object doc-attribute">



<h4 id="docling.datamodel.pipeline_options.PaginatedPipelineOptions.document_timeout" class="doc doc-heading">
<code class="doc-symbol doc-symbol-heading doc-symbol-attribute"></code>            <span class="doc doc-object-name doc-attribute-name">document_timeout</span>


  <span class="doc doc-labels">
      <small class="doc doc-label doc-label-pydantic-field"><code>pydantic-field</code></small>
  </span>

</h4>
<div class="doc-signature highlight"><pre><span></span><code><span class="n">document_timeout</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n"><span title="float">float</span></span> <span class="o">|</span> <span class="kc">None</span>
</code></pre></div>

    <div class="doc doc-contents ">

        <p>Maximum processing time in seconds before aborting document conversion. When exceeded, the pipeline stops processing and returns partial results with PARTIAL_SUCCESS status. Timeout errors are recorded in ConversionResult.errors with category=TIMEOUT and descriptive error messages. Use ConversionResult.has_timeout_errors() to detect timeouts. If None, no timeout is enforced. Recommended: 90-120 seconds for production systems.</p>

    </div>

</div>

<div class="doc doc-object doc-attribute">

  </span>

</code></pre></div>

    <div class="doc doc-contents ">

        <p>Allow pipeline to call external APIs or cloud services during processing. Required for API-based picture description models. Disabled by default for security and offline operation.</p>

    </div>

</div>

<h3 id="docling.datamodel.pipeline_options.PdfBackend" class="doc doc-heading">
<code class="doc-symbol doc-symbol-heading doc-symbol-class"></code>            <span class="doc doc-object-name doc-class-name">PdfBackend</span>

    <div class="doc doc-contents ">
            <p class="doc doc-class-bases">
              Bases: <code><span title="str">str</span></code>, <code><span title="enum.Enum">Enum</span></code></p>



        <p>Available PDF parsing backends for document processing.</p>
<p>Different backends offer varying levels of text extraction quality, layout
preservation, and processing speed. Choose based on your document complexity
and quality requirements.</p>

<h3 id="docling.datamodel.pipeline_options.PdfPipelineOptions" class="doc doc-heading">
<code class="doc-symbol doc-symbol-heading doc-symbol-class"></code>            <span class="doc doc-object-name doc-class-name">PdfPipelineOptions</span>


  <span class="doc doc-labels">
      <small class="doc doc-label doc-label-pydantic-model"><code>pydantic-model</code></small>
  </span>

</h3>


    <div class="doc doc-contents ">
            <p class="doc doc-class-bases">
              Bases: <code><a class="autorefs autorefs-internal" title="&lt;code class=&quot;doc-symbol doc-symbol-heading doc-symbol-class&quot;&gt;&lt;/code&gt;            &lt;span class=&quot;doc doc-object-name doc-class-name&quot;&gt;PaginatedPipelineOptions&lt;/span&gt;


  &lt;span class=&quot;doc doc-labels&quot;&gt;
      &lt;small class=&quot;doc doc-label doc-label-pydantic-model&quot;&gt;&lt;code&gt;pydantic-model&lt;/code&gt;&lt;/small&gt;
  &lt;/span&gt;" href="./#docling.datamodel.pipeline_options.PaginatedPipelineOptions">PaginatedPipelineOptions</a></code></p>

        <p>Configuration options for the PDF document processing pipeline.</p>


<details class="notes" open>
  <summary>Notes</summary>
  <ul>
<li>Enabling multiple features (OCR, table structure, formulas) increases the processing time significantly.
    Enable only necessary features for your use case.</li>
<li>For production systems processing large document volumes, implement a timeout protection (for instance, 90-120
    seconds via <code>document_timeout</code> parameter).</li>
<li>OCR requires a system installation of engines (Tesseract, EasyOCR). Verify the installation before enabling
    OCR via <code>do_ocr=True</code>.</li>
<li>RapidOCR has known issues with read-only filesystems (e.g., Databricks). Consider Tesseract or alternative
    backends for distributed systems.</li>
</ul>
</details>

<details class="see-also" open>
  <summary>See Also</summary>
  <ul>
<li><code>examples/pipeline_options_advanced.py</code>: Comprehensive configuration examples.</li>
</ul>
</details>

<span class="w">      </span><span class="nt">"type"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"integer"</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">},</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="nt">"batch_polling_interval_seconds"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span>
<span class="w">      </span><span class="nt">"default"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mf">0.5</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="w">      </span><span class="nt">"description"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"Polling interval in seconds for batch collection in threaded pipeline stages. Each stage waits up to this duration to accumulate items before processing. Lower values reduce latency but may decrease batching efficiency. Only used by `StandardPdfPipeline` (threaded mode)."</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="w">      </span><span class="nt">"title"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"Batch Polling Interval Seconds"</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="w">      </span><span class="nt">"type"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"number"</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">},</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="nt">"queue_max_size"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span>
<span class="w">      </span><span class="nt">"default"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">100</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="w">      </span><span class="nt">"description"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"Maximum queue size for inter-stage communication in threaded pipeline. Limits the number of items buffered between processing stages to prevent memory overflow. When full, upstream stages block until space is available. Only used by `StandardPdfPipeline` (threaded mode)."</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="w">      </span><span class="nt">"title"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"Queue Max Size"</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="w">      </span><span class="nt">"type"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"integer"</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">},</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="nt">"stage_shutdown_timeout_seconds"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span>
<span class="w">      </span><span class="nt">"default"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mf">15.0</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="w">      </span><span class="nt">"description"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"Seconds to wait for each pipeline stage thread to terminate during shutdown before it is abandoned as stuck (its resources may then leak for the rest of the process lifetime). Only used by `StandardPdfPipeline` (threaded mode)."</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="w">      </span><span class="nt">"title"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"Stage Shutdown Timeout Seconds"</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="w">      </span><span class="nt">"type"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"number"</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">}</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="p">},</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nt">"title"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"PdfPipelineOptions"</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nt">"type"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"object"</span>
<span class="p">}</span>
</code></pre></div>

<h4 id="docling.datamodel.pipeline_options.PdfPipelineOptions.document_timeout" class="doc doc-heading">
<code class="doc-symbol doc-symbol-heading doc-symbol-attribute"></code>            <span class="doc doc-object-name doc-attribute-name">document_timeout</span>


  <span class="doc doc-labels">
      <small class="doc doc-label doc-label-pydantic-field"><code>pydantic-field</code></small>
  </span>

</h4>
<div class="doc-signature highlight"><pre><span></span><code><span class="n">document_timeout</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n"><span title="float">float</span></span> <span class="o">|</span> <span class="kc">None</span>
</code></pre></div>

    <div class="doc doc-contents ">

        <p>Maximum processing time in seconds before aborting document conversion. When exceeded, the pipeline stops processing and returns partial results with PARTIAL_SUCCESS status. Timeout errors are recorded in ConversionResult.errors with category=TIMEOUT and descriptive error messages. Use ConversionResult.has_timeout_errors() to detect timeouts. If None, no timeout is enforced. Recommended: 90-120 seconds for production systems.</p>

    </div>

</div>

  </span>

</h4>

</code></pre></div>

    <div class="doc doc-contents ">

        <p>Number of images to process in a single batch during picture description. Higher values improve throughput but increase memory usage. Adjust based on available GPU/CPU memory.</p>

<div class="doc doc-object doc-attribute">



<h4 id="docling.datamodel.pipeline_options.PictureDescriptionApiOptions.classification_allow" class="doc doc-heading">
<code class="doc-symbol doc-symbol-heading doc-symbol-attribute"></code>            <span class="doc doc-object-name doc-attribute-name">classification_allow</span>


  <span class="doc doc-labels">
      <small class="doc doc-label doc-label-pydantic-field"><code>pydantic-field</code></small>
  </span>

</h4>
<div class="doc-signature highlight"><pre><span></span><code><span class="n">classification_allow</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="p">(</span>
    <span class="n"><span title="list">list</span></span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n"><span title="docling_core.types.doc.PictureClassificationLabel">PictureClassificationLabel</span></span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">|</span> <span class="kc">None</span>
<span class="p">)</span>
</code></pre></div>

    <div class="doc doc-contents ">

        <p>List of picture classification labels to allow for description. Only pictures classified with these labels will be processed. If None, all picture types are allowed unless explicitly denied. Use to focus description on specific image types (e.g., diagrams, charts).</p>

    </div>

</div>

<div class="doc doc-object doc-attribute">



<h4 id="docling.datamodel.pipeline_options.PictureDescriptionApiOptions.classification_deny" class="doc doc-heading">
<code class="doc-symbol doc-symbol-heading doc-symbol-attribute"></code>            <span class="doc doc-object-name doc-attribute-name">classification_deny</span>


  <span class="doc doc-labels">
      <small class="doc doc-label doc-label-pydantic-field"><code>pydantic-field</code></small>
  </span>

</h4>
<div class="doc-signature highlight"><pre><span></span><code><span class="n">classification_deny</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n"><span title="list">list</span></span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n"><span title="docling_core.types.doc.PictureClassificationLabel">PictureClassificationLabel</span></span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">|</span> <span class="kc">None</span>
</code></pre></div>

    <div class="doc doc-contents ">

        <p>List of picture classification labels to exclude from description. Pictures classified with these labels will be skipped. If None, no picture types are denied unless not in allow list. Use to exclude unwanted image types (e.g., decorative images, logos).</p>

    </div>

</div>

<div class="doc doc-object doc-attribute">



<h4 id="docling.datamodel.pipeline_options.PictureDescriptionApiOptions.classification_min_confidence" class="doc doc-heading">
<code class="doc-symbol doc-symbol-heading doc-symbol-attribute"></code>            <span class="doc doc-object-name doc-attribute-name">classification_min_confidence</span>


  <span class="doc doc-labels">
      <small class="doc doc-label doc-label-pydantic-field"><code>pydantic-field</code></small>
  </span>

</h4>
<div class="doc-signature highlight"><pre><span></span><code><span class="n">classification_min_confidence</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n"><span title="float">float</span></span>
</code></pre></div>

    <div class="doc doc-contents ">

        <p>Minimum classification confidence score (0.0-1.0) required for a picture to be processed. Pictures with classification confidence below this threshold are skipped. Higher values ensure only confidently classified images are described. Range: 0.0 (no filtering) to 1.0 (maximum confidence).</p>

    </div>

</div>

<h3 id="docling.datamodel.pipeline_options.PictureDescriptionBaseOptions" class="doc doc-heading">
<code class="doc-symbol doc-symbol-heading doc-symbol-class"></code>            <span class="doc doc-object-name doc-class-name">PictureDescriptionBaseOptions</span>


  <span class="doc doc-labels">
      <small class="doc doc-label doc-label-pydantic-model"><code>pydantic-model</code></small>
  </span>

</h3>


    <div class="doc doc-contents ">
            <p class="doc doc-class-bases">
              Bases: <code><a class="autorefs autorefs-internal" title="&lt;code class=&quot;doc-symbol doc-symbol-heading doc-symbol-class&quot;&gt;&lt;/code&gt;            &lt;span class=&quot;doc doc-object-name doc-class-name&quot;&gt;BaseOptions&lt;/span&gt;


  &lt;span class=&quot;doc doc-labels&quot;&gt;
      &lt;small class=&quot;doc doc-label doc-label-pydantic-model&quot;&gt;&lt;code&gt;pydantic-model&lt;/code&gt;&lt;/small&gt;
  &lt;/span&gt;" href="./#docling.datamodel.pipeline_options.BaseOptions">BaseOptions</a></code></p>

        <p>Base configuration for picture description models.</p>
<p>Provides shared parameters for all picture description backends,
including batch processing, image scaling, area thresholds, and
classification-based filtering (allow/deny lists). Concrete
implementations supply the actual model integration.</p>


<details class="see-also" open>
  <summary>See Also</summary>
  <p><code>PictureDescriptionApiOptions</code>: OpenAI-compatible API backend.
<code>PictureDescriptionVlmOptions</code>: Legacy HuggingFace Transformers
    backend.
<code>PictureDescriptionVlmEngineOptions</code>: New runtime-based backend
    with preset support (recommended).</p>
</details>

<h4 id="docling.datamodel.pipeline_options.PictureDescriptionBaseOptions.batch_size" class="doc doc-heading">
<code class="doc-symbol doc-symbol-heading doc-symbol-attribute"></code>            <span class="doc doc-object-name doc-attribute-name">batch_size</span>


  <span class="doc doc-labels">
      <small class="doc doc-label doc-label-pydantic-field"><code>pydantic-field</code></small>
  </span>

</h4>
<div class="doc-signature highlight"><pre><span></span><code><span class="n">batch_size</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n"><span title="int">int</span></span>
</code></pre></div>

    <div class="doc doc-contents ">

        <p>Number of images to process in a single batch during picture description. Higher values improve throughput but increase memory usage. Adjust based on available GPU/CPU memory.</p>

    </div>

</div>

<div class="doc doc-object doc-attribute">



<h4 id="docling.datamodel.pipeline_options.PictureDescriptionBaseOptions.classification_allow" class="doc doc-heading">
<code class="doc-symbol doc-symbol-heading doc-symbol-attribute"></code>            <span class="doc doc-object-name doc-attribute-name">classification_allow</span>


  <span class="doc doc-labels">
      <small class="doc doc-label doc-label-pydantic-field"><code>pydantic-field</code></small>
  </span>

</h4>
<div class="doc-signature highlight"><pre><span></span><code><span class="n">classification_allow</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="p">(</span>
    <span class="n"><span title="list">list</span></span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n"><span title="docling_core.types.doc.PictureClassificationLabel">PictureClassificationLabel</span></span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">|</span> <span class="kc">None</span>
<span class="p">)</span>
</code></pre></div>

    <div class="doc doc-contents ">

        <p>List of picture classification labels to allow for description. Only pictures classified with these labels will be processed. If None, all picture types are allowed unless explicitly denied. Use to focus description on specific image types (e.g., diagrams, charts).</p>

    </div>

</div>

<div class="doc doc-object doc-attribute">



<h4 id="docling.datamodel.pipeline_options.PictureDescriptionBaseOptions.classification_deny" class="doc doc-heading">
<code class="doc-symbol doc-symbol-heading doc-symbol-attribute"></code>            <span class="doc doc-object-name doc-attribute-name">classification_deny</span>


  <span class="doc doc-labels">
      <small class="doc doc-label doc-label-pydantic-field"><code>pydantic-field</code></small>
  </span>

</h4>
<div class="doc-signature highlight"><pre><span></span><code><span class="n">classification_deny</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n"><span title="list">list</span></span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n"><span title="docling_core.types.doc.PictureClassificationLabel">PictureClassificationLabel</span></span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">|</span> <span class="kc">None</span>
</code></pre></div>

    <div class="doc doc-contents ">

        <p>List of picture classification labels to exclude from description. Pictures classified with these labels will be skipped. If None, no picture types are denied unless not in allow list. Use to exclude unwanted image types (e.g., decorative images, logos).</p>

    </div>

</div>

<div class="doc doc-object doc-attribute">



<h4 id="docling.datamodel.pipeline_options.PictureDescriptionBaseOptions.classification_min_confidence" class="doc doc-heading">
<code class="doc-symbol doc-symbol-heading doc-symbol-attribute"></code>            <span class="doc doc-object-name doc-attribute-name">classification_min_confidence</span>


  <span class="doc doc-labels">
      <small class="doc doc-label doc-label-pydantic-field"><code>pydantic-field</code></small>
  </span>

</h4>
<div class="doc-signature highlight"><pre><span></span><code><span class="n">classification_min_confidence</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n"><span title="float">float</span></span>
</code></pre></div>

    <div class="doc doc-contents ">

        <p>Minimum classification confidence score (0.0-1.0) required for a picture to be processed. Pictures with classification confidence below this threshold are skipped. Higher values ensure only confidently classified images are described. Range: 0.0 (no filtering) to 1.0 (maximum confidence).</p>

    </div>

</div>

<h3 id="docling.datamodel.pipeline_options.PictureDescriptionVlmEngineOptions" class="doc doc-heading">
<code class="doc-symbol doc-symbol-heading doc-symbol-class"></code>            <span class="doc doc-object-name doc-class-name">PictureDescriptionVlmEngineOptions</span>


  <span class="doc doc-labels">
      <small class="doc doc-label doc-label-pydantic-model"><code>pydantic-model</code></small>
  </span>

</h3>


    <div class="doc doc-contents ">
            <p class="doc doc-class-bases">
              Bases: <code><span title="docling.datamodel.stage_model_specs.StagePresetMixin">StagePresetMixin</span></code>, <code><span title="docling.models.inference_engines.vlm.base.VlmEngineOptionsMixin">VlmEngineOptionsMixin</span></code>, <code><a class="autorefs autorefs-internal" title="&lt;code class=&quot;doc-symbol doc-symbol-heading doc-symbol-class&quot;&gt;&lt;/code&gt;            &lt;span class=&quot;doc doc-object-name doc-class-name&quot;&gt;PictureDescriptionBaseOptions&lt;/span&gt;


  &lt;span class=&quot;doc doc-labels&quot;&gt;
      &lt;small class=&quot;doc doc-label doc-label-pydantic-model&quot;&gt;&lt;code&gt;pydantic-model&lt;/code&gt;&lt;/small&gt;
  &lt;/span&gt;" href="./#docling.datamodel.pipeline_options.PictureDescriptionBaseOptions">PictureDescriptionBaseOptions</a></code></p>

        <p>Configuration for VLM runtime-based picture description.</p>
<p>This is the new implementation that uses the pluggable runtime system with preset support.
Supports all runtime types (Transformers, MLX, API, etc.) through the unified runtime interface.</p>
<p>Use <code>from_preset()</code> to create instances from registered presets.</p>


<p><span class="doc-section-title">Examples:</span></p>
    <h4 id="docling.datamodel.pipeline_options.PictureDescriptionVlmEngineOptions--use-preset-with-default-runtime">Use preset with default runtime</h4>
<p>options = PictureDescriptionVlmEngineOptions.from_preset("smolvlm")</p>
<h4 id="docling.datamodel.pipeline_options.PictureDescriptionVlmEngineOptions--use-preset-with-runtime-override">Use preset with runtime override</h4>
<p>from docling.datamodel.vlm_engine_options import MlxVlmEngineOptions, VlmEngineType
options = PictureDescriptionVlmEngineOptions.from_preset(
    "smolvlm",
    engine_options=MlxVlmEngineOptions(engine_type=VlmEngineType.MLX)
)</p>

<h4 id="docling.datamodel.pipeline_options.PictureDescriptionVlmEngineOptions.classification_allow" class="doc doc-heading">
<code class="doc-symbol doc-symbol-heading doc-symbol-attribute"></code>            <span class="doc doc-object-name doc-attribute-name">classification_allow</span>


  <span class="doc doc-labels">
      <small class="doc doc-label doc-label-pydantic-field"><code>pydantic-field</code></small>
  </span>

</h4>
<div class="doc-signature highlight"><pre><span></span><code><span class="n">classification_allow</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="p">(</span>
    <span class="n"><span title="list">list</span></span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n"><span title="docling_core.types.doc.PictureClassificationLabel">PictureClassificationLabel</span></span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">|</span> <span class="kc">None</span>
<span class="p">)</span>
</code></pre></div>

    <div class="doc doc-contents ">

        <p>List of picture classification labels to allow for description. Only pictures classified with these labels will be processed. If None, all picture types are allowed unless explicitly denied. Use to focus description on specific image types (e.g., diagrams, charts).</p>

    </div>

</div>

<div class="doc doc-object doc-attribute">



<h4 id="docling.datamodel.pipeline_options.PictureDescriptionVlmEngineOptions.classification_deny" class="doc doc-heading">
<code class="doc-symbol doc-symbol-heading doc-symbol-attribute"></code>            <span class="doc doc-object-name doc-attribute-name">classification_deny</span>


  <span class="doc doc-labels">
      <small class="doc doc-label doc-label-pydantic-field"><code>pydantic-field</code></small>
  </span>

</h4>
<div class="doc-signature highlight"><pre><span></span><code><span class="n">classification_deny</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n"><span title="list">list</span></span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n"><span title="docling_core.types.doc.PictureClassificationLabel">PictureClassificationLabel</span></span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">|</span> <span class="kc">None</span>
</code></pre></div>

    <div class="doc doc-contents ">

        <p>List of picture classification labels to exclude from description. Pictures classified with these labels will be skipped. If None, no picture types are denied unless not in allow list. Use to exclude unwanted image types (e.g., decorative images, logos).</p>

    </div>

<h4 id="docling.datamodel.pipeline_options.PictureDescriptionVlmEngineOptions.classification_min_confidence" class="doc doc-heading">
<code class="doc-symbol doc-symbol-heading doc-symbol-attribute"></code>            <span class="doc doc-object-name doc-attribute-name">classification_min_confidence</span>


  <span class="doc doc-labels">
      <small class="doc doc-label doc-label-pydantic-field"><code>pydantic-field</code></small>
  </span>

</h4>
<div class="doc-signature highlight"><pre><span></span><code><span class="n">classification_min_confidence</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n"><span title="float">float</span></span>
</code></pre></div>

    <div class="doc doc-contents ">

        <p>Minimum classification confidence score (0.0-1.0) required for a picture to be processed. Pictures with classification confidence below this threshold are skipped. Higher values ensure only confidently classified images are described. Range: 0.0 (no filtering) to 1.0 (maximum confidence).</p>

    </div>

<div class="doc doc-object doc-attribute">



<h4 id="docling.datamodel.pipeline_options.PictureDescriptionVlmOptions.batch_size" class="doc doc-heading">
<code class="doc-symbol doc-symbol-heading doc-symbol-attribute"></code>            <span class="doc doc-object-name doc-attribute-name">batch_size</span>


  <span class="doc doc-labels">
      <small class="doc doc-label doc-label-pydantic-field"><code>pydantic-field</code></small>
  </span>

</h4>
<div class="doc-signature highlight"><pre><span></span><code><span class="n">batch_size</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n"><span title="int">int</span></span>
</code></pre></div>

    <div class="doc doc-contents ">

        <p>Number of images to process in a single batch during picture description. Higher values improve throughput but increase memory usage. Adjust based on available GPU/CPU memory.</p>

    </div>

</div>

<div class="doc doc-object doc-attribute">



<h4 id="docling.datamodel.pipeline_options.PictureDescriptionVlmOptions.classification_allow" class="doc doc-heading">
<code class="doc-symbol doc-symbol-heading doc-symbol-attribute"></code>            <span class="doc doc-object-name doc-attribute-name">classification_allow</span>


  <span class="doc doc-labels">
      <small class="doc doc-label doc-label-pydantic-field"><code>pydantic-field</code></small>
  </span>

</h4>
<div class="doc-signature highlight"><pre><span></span><code><span class="n">classification_allow</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="p">(</span>
    <span class="n"><span title="list">list</span></span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n"><span title="docling_core.types.doc.PictureClassificationLabel">PictureClassificationLabel</span></span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">|</span> <span class="kc">None</span>
<span class="p">)</span>
</code></pre></div>

    <div class="doc doc-contents ">

        <p>List of picture classification labels to allow for description. Only pictures classified with these labels will be processed. If None, all picture types are allowed unless explicitly denied. Use to focus description on specific image types (e.g., diagrams, charts).</p>

    </div>

</div>

<div class="doc doc-object doc-attribute">



<h4 id="docling.datamodel.pipeline_options.PictureDescriptionVlmOptions.classification_deny" class="doc doc-heading">
<code class="doc-symbol doc-symbol-heading doc-symbol-attribute"></code>            <span class="doc doc-object-name doc-attribute-name">classification_deny</span>


  <span class="doc doc-labels">
      <small class="doc doc-label doc-label-pydantic-field"><code>pydantic-field</code></small>
  </span>

</h4>
<div class="doc-signature highlight"><pre><span></span><code><span class="n">classification_deny</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n"><span title="list">list</span></span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n"><span title="docling_core.types.doc.PictureClassificationLabel">PictureClassificationLabel</span></span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">|</span> <span class="kc">None</span>
</code></pre></div>

    <div class="doc doc-contents ">

        <p>List of picture classification labels to exclude from description. Pictures classified with these labels will be skipped. If None, no picture types are denied unless not in allow list. Use to exclude unwanted image types (e.g., decorative images, logos).</p>

    </div>

</div>

<div class="doc doc-object doc-attribute">



<h4 id="docling.datamodel.pipeline_options.PictureDescriptionVlmOptions.classification_min_confidence" class="doc doc-heading">
<code class="doc-symbol doc-symbol-heading doc-symbol-attribute"></code>            <span class="doc doc-object-name doc-attribute-name">classification_min_confidence</span>


  <span class="doc doc-labels">
      <small class="doc doc-label doc-label-pydantic-field"><code>pydantic-field</code></small>
  </span>

</h4>
<div class="doc-signature highlight"><pre><span></span><code><span class="n">classification_min_confidence</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n"><span title="float">float</span></span>
</code></pre></div>

    <div class="doc doc-contents ">

        <p>Minimum classification confidence score (0.0-1.0) required for a picture to be processed. Pictures with classification confidence below this threshold are skipped. Higher values ensure only confidently classified images are described. Range: 0.0 (no filtering) to 1.0 (maximum confidence).</p>

    </div>

</div>

<div class="doc doc-object doc-attribute">



<h4 id="docling.datamodel.pipeline_options.PictureDescriptionVlmOptions.generation_config" class="doc doc-heading">
<code class="doc-symbol doc-symbol-heading doc-symbol-attribute"></code>            <span class="doc doc-object-name doc-attribute-name">generation_config</span>


  <span class="doc doc-labels">

<div class="doc-signature highlight"><pre><span></span><code><span class="n">generation_config</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n"><span title="dict">dict</span></span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n"><span title="str">str</span></span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n"><span title="typing.Any">Any</span></span><span class="p">]</span>
</code></pre></div>

    <div class="doc doc-contents ">

        <p>HuggingFace generation configuration for text generation. Controls output length, sampling strategy, temperature, etc. See: https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/en/main_classes/text_generation#transformers.GenerationConfig</p>

<div class="doc doc-object doc-attribute">



<h4 id="docling.datamodel.pipeline_options.PictureDescriptionVlmOptions.padding_side" class="doc doc-heading">
<code class="doc-symbol doc-symbol-heading doc-symbol-attribute"></code>            <span class="doc doc-object-name doc-attribute-name">padding_side</span>

<div class="doc doc-object doc-attribute">



<h4 id="docling.datamodel.pipeline_options.PictureDescriptionVlmOptions.picture_area_threshold" class="doc doc-heading">

    <div class="doc doc-contents ">

<h3 id="docling.datamodel.pipeline_options.PipelineOptions" class="doc doc-heading">
<code class="doc-symbol doc-symbol-heading doc-symbol-class"></code>            <span class="doc doc-object-name doc-class-name">PipelineOptions</span>


  <span class="doc doc-labels">
      <small class="doc doc-label doc-label-pydantic-model"><code>pydantic-model</code></small>

</h3>


    <div class="doc doc-contents ">
            <p class="doc doc-class-bases">
              Bases: <code><a class="autorefs autorefs-internal" title="&lt;code class=&quot;doc-symbol doc-symbol-heading doc-symbol-class&quot;&gt;&lt;/code&gt;            &lt;span class=&quot;doc doc-object-name doc-class-name&quot;&gt;BaseOptions&lt;/span&gt;


  &lt;span class=&quot;doc doc-labels&quot;&gt;
      &lt;small class=&quot;doc doc-label doc-label-pydantic-model&quot;&gt;&lt;code&gt;pydantic-model&lt;/code&gt;&lt;/small&gt;
  &lt;/span&gt;" href="./#docling.datamodel.pipeline_options.BaseOptions">BaseOptions</a></code></p>

        <p>Base configuration for document processing pipelines.</p>
<p>Provides the foundational settings shared by every pipeline type:
document-level timeout, hardware accelerator selection, remote service
permissions, external plugin control, and model artifact paths. All
specialized pipeline option classes inherit from this base.</p>

<div class="doc doc-object doc-attribute">



<h4 id="docling.datamodel.pipeline_options.PipelineOptions.allow_external_plugins" class="doc doc-heading">
<code class="doc-symbol doc-symbol-heading doc-symbol-attribute"></code>            <span class="doc doc-object-name doc-attribute-name">allow_external_plugins</span>


  <span class="doc doc-labels">
      <small class="doc doc-label doc-label-pydantic-field"><code>pydantic-field</code></small>
  </span>

</code></pre></div>

    <div class="doc doc-contents ">

        <p>Allow loading external third-party plugins for OCR, layout, table structure, or picture description models. Enables custom model implementations via plugin system. Disabled by default for security.</p>
