<h4 id="docling.datamodel.pipeline_options.PipelineOptions.artifacts_path" class="doc doc-heading">
<code class="doc-symbol doc-symbol-heading doc-symbol-attribute"></code>            <span class="doc doc-object-name doc-attribute-name">artifacts_path</span>


  <span class="doc doc-labels">
      <small class="doc doc-label doc-label-pydantic-field"><code>pydantic-field</code></small>
  </span>

</h4>
<div class="doc-signature highlight"><pre><span></span><code><span class="n">artifacts_path</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n"><span title="pathlib.Path">Path</span></span> <span class="o">|</span> <span class="n"><span title="str">str</span></span> <span class="o">|</span> <span class="kc">None</span>
</code></pre></div>

    <div class="doc doc-contents ">

        <p>Local directory containing pre-downloaded model artifacts (weights, configs). If None, models are fetched from remote sources on first use. Use <code>docling-tools models download</code> to pre-fetch artifacts for offline operation or faster initialization.</p>

    </div>

<div class="doc doc-object doc-attribute">



<h4 id="docling.datamodel.pipeline_options.PipelineOptions.document_timeout" class="doc doc-heading">
<code class="doc-symbol doc-symbol-heading doc-symbol-attribute"></code>            <span class="doc doc-object-name doc-attribute-name">document_timeout</span>


  <span class="doc doc-labels">
      <small class="doc doc-label doc-label-pydantic-field"><code>pydantic-field</code></small>
  </span>

</h4>
<div class="doc-signature highlight"><pre><span></span><code><span class="n">document_timeout</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n"><span title="float">float</span></span> <span class="o">|</span> <span class="kc">None</span>
</code></pre></div>

    <div class="doc doc-contents ">

        <p>Maximum processing time in seconds before aborting document conversion. When exceeded, the pipeline stops processing and returns partial results with PARTIAL_SUCCESS status. Timeout errors are recorded in ConversionResult.errors with category=TIMEOUT and descriptive error messages. Use ConversionResult.has_timeout_errors() to detect timeouts. If None, no timeout is enforced. Recommended: 90-120 seconds for production systems.</p>

    </div>

</div>

    <div class="doc doc-contents ">

<p>Each pipeline is optimized for specific document types and processing requirements.
Select the appropriate pipeline based on your input format and desired output.</p>

  &lt;/span&gt;" href="./#docling.datamodel.pipeline_options.RapidOcrBackend">RapidOcrBackend</a></span>
</code></pre></div>

    <div class="doc doc-contents ">

        <p>Inference backend for RapidOCR. Options: <code>onnxruntime</code> (default, cross-platform), <code>openvino</code> (Intel), <code>paddle</code> (PaddlePaddle), <code>torch</code> (PyTorch). Choose based on your hardware and available libraries. Note: for languages outside the PP-OCRv6 set, <code>torch</code> is limited to the PP-OCRv4 script models while the other backends use the wider PP-OCRv5 set (see <code>lang</code>).</p>

    </div>

<div class="doc doc-object doc-attribute">



<h4 id="docling.datamodel.pipeline_options.RapidOcrOptions.lang" class="doc doc-heading">
<code class="doc-symbol doc-symbol-heading doc-symbol-attribute"></code>            <span class="doc doc-object-name doc-attribute-name">lang</span>


  <span class="doc doc-labels">
      <small class="doc doc-label doc-label-pydantic-field"><code>pydantic-field</code></small>
  </span>

</h4>
<div class="doc-signature highlight"><pre><span></span><code><span class="n">lang</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n"><span title="list">list</span></span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n"><span title="str">str</span></span><span class="p">]</span>
</code></pre></div>

    <div class="doc doc-contents ">

        <p>Recognition language, written as a PP-OCR code (<code>ch</code>, <code>latin</code>, <code>cyrillic</code>) or as a BCP-47 tag behind the <code>iso:</code> prefix. RapidOCR runs a single language per run; if more than one is given the first is used and the rest are ignored with a warning. A tag is mapped onto a PP-OCR recognizer: PP-OCRv6 covers ~52 languages, and a language PP-OCR serves only through a script-wide recognizer routes to PP-OCRv5 (onnxruntime/openvino/paddle) or PP-OCRv4 (torch). An empty list selects the Simplified Chinese default. A language the resolved backend cannot serve raises an error rather than falling back silently. The pre-canonicalization docling spellings <code>chinese</code> and <code>english</code> still resolve to <code>ch</code> and <code>en</code>, with a warning.</p>

    </div>

</div>

<div class="doc doc-object doc-attribute">



<h4 id="docling.datamodel.pipeline_options.TesseractCliOcrOptions.lang" class="doc doc-heading">
<code class="doc-symbol doc-symbol-heading doc-symbol-attribute"></code>            <span class="doc doc-object-name doc-attribute-name">lang</span>


  <span class="doc doc-labels">
      <small class="doc doc-label doc-label-pydantic-field"><code>pydantic-field</code></small>
  </span>

</h4>
<div class="doc-signature highlight"><pre><span></span><code><span class="n">lang</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n"><span title="list">list</span></span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n"><span title="str">str</span></span><span class="p">]</span>
</code></pre></div>

    <div class="doc doc-contents ">

        <p>OCR languages, written as the stems of the installed tessdata files (<code>deu</code>, <code>chi_tra</code>, <code>script/Cyrillic</code>, a traineddata file of your own) or as BCP-47 tags behind the <code>iso:</code> prefix, which are mapped onto those files (<code>iso:de</code> becomes <code>deu</code>, <code>iso:zh-Hant</code> becomes <code>chi_tra</code>). Multiple languages enable multilingual OCR and are joined in the order given, which Tesseract treats as preference order. An empty list runs orientation and script detection per page (requires the <code>osd</code> traineddata). Languages without an installed traineddata file raise at construction time.</p>

    </div>

</div>

<div class="doc doc-object doc-attribute">



<h4 id="docling.datamodel.pipeline_options.TesseractCliOcrOptions.psm" class="doc doc-heading">
<code class="doc-symbol doc-symbol-heading doc-symbol-attribute"></code>            <span class="doc doc-object-name doc-attribute-name">psm</span>


  <span class="doc doc-labels">
      <small class="doc doc-label doc-label-pydantic-field"><code>pydantic-field</code></small>
  </span>

</h4>
<div class="doc-signature highlight"><pre><span></span><code><span class="n">psm</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n"><span title="int">int</span></span> <span class="o">|</span> <span class="kc">None</span>
</code></pre></div>

    <div class="doc doc-contents ">

        <p>Page Segmentation Mode for Tesseract. Values 0-13 control how Tesseract segments the page. Common values: 3 (auto), 6 (uniform block), 11 (sparse text). If None, uses Tesseract default.</p>

    </div>

</div>

<div class="doc doc-object doc-attribute">



<h4 id="docling.datamodel.pipeline_options.TesseractCliOcrOptions.scale" class="doc doc-heading">
<code class="doc-symbol doc-symbol-heading doc-symbol-attribute"></code>            <span class="doc doc-object-name doc-attribute-name">scale</span>


  <span class="doc doc-labels">
      <small class="doc doc-label doc-label-pydantic-field"><code>pydantic-field</code></small>
  </span>

</h4>
<div class="doc-signature highlight"><pre><span></span><code><span class="n">scale</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n"><span title="float">float</span></span>
</code></pre></div>

    <div class="doc doc-contents ">

        <p>Image scale multiplier applied before running OCR. The page is rendered at 72 DPI times this factor, so the default 3 yields 216 DPI. Lower it when the source image is already high resolution and upscaling degrades recognition.</p>

    </div>

</div>

<div class="doc doc-object doc-attribute">



<h4 id="docling.datamodel.pipeline_options.TesseractOcrOptions.lang" class="doc doc-heading">
<code class="doc-symbol doc-symbol-heading doc-symbol-attribute"></code>            <span class="doc doc-object-name doc-attribute-name">lang</span>


  <span class="doc doc-labels">
      <small class="doc doc-label doc-label-pydantic-field"><code>pydantic-field</code></small>
  </span>

</h4>
<div class="doc-signature highlight"><pre><span></span><code><span class="n">lang</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n"><span title="list">list</span></span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n"><span title="str">str</span></span><span class="p">]</span>
</code></pre></div>

    <div class="doc doc-contents ">

        <p>OCR languages, written as the stems of the installed tessdata files (<code>deu</code>, <code>chi_tra</code>, <code>script/Cyrillic</code>, a traineddata file of your own) or as BCP-47 tags behind the <code>iso:</code> prefix, which are mapped onto those files (<code>iso:de</code> becomes <code>deu</code>, <code>iso:zh-Hant</code> becomes <code>chi_tra</code>). Multiple languages enable multilingual OCR and are joined in the order given, which Tesseract treats as preference order. An empty list runs orientation and script detection per page (requires the <code>osd</code> traineddata). Languages without an installed traineddata file raise at construction time.</p>

    </div>

</div>

<h4 id="docling.datamodel.pipeline_options.TesseractOcrOptions.scale" class="doc doc-heading">

<h3 id="docling.datamodel.pipeline_options.ThreadedPdfPipelineOptions" class="doc doc-heading">
<code class="doc-symbol doc-symbol-heading doc-symbol-class"></code>            <span class="doc doc-object-name doc-class-name">ThreadedPdfPipelineOptions</span>


  <span class="doc doc-labels">
      <small class="doc doc-label doc-label-pydantic-model"><code>pydantic-model</code></small>
  </span>

</h3>


    <div class="doc doc-contents ">
            <p class="doc doc-class-bases">
              Bases: <code><a class="autorefs autorefs-internal" title="&lt;code class=&quot;doc-symbol doc-symbol-heading doc-symbol-class&quot;&gt;&lt;/code&gt;            &lt;span class=&quot;doc doc-object-name doc-class-name&quot;&gt;PdfPipelineOptions&lt;/span&gt;


  &lt;span class=&quot;doc doc-labels&quot;&gt;
      &lt;small class=&quot;doc doc-label doc-label-pydantic-model&quot;&gt;&lt;code&gt;pydantic-model&lt;/code&gt;&lt;/small&gt;
  &lt;/span&gt;" href="./#docling.datamodel.pipeline_options.PdfPipelineOptions">PdfPipelineOptions</a></code></p>

        <p>Pipeline options for the threaded PDF pipeline with batching and backpressure control.</p>
<p>Inherits all settings from <code>PdfPipelineOptions</code>. The threaded pipeline
processes pages through concurrent stages (OCR, layout analysis, table
structure extraction) connected by bounded queues, enabling pipelined
parallelism within a single document. Batch sizes, polling intervals,
and queue limits are inherited from the parent class.</p>


<details class="see-also" open>

<h4 id="docling.datamodel.pipeline_options.ThreadedPdfPipelineOptions.document_timeout" class="doc doc-heading">
<code class="doc-symbol doc-symbol-heading doc-symbol-attribute"></code>            <span class="doc doc-object-name doc-attribute-name">document_timeout</span>


  <span class="doc doc-labels">
      <small class="doc doc-label doc-label-pydantic-field"><code>pydantic-field</code></small>
  </span>

</h4>
<div class="doc-signature highlight"><pre><span></span><code><span class="n">document_timeout</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n"><span title="float">float</span></span> <span class="o">|</span> <span class="kc">None</span>
</code></pre></div>

    <div class="doc doc-contents ">

        <p>Maximum processing time in seconds before aborting document conversion. When exceeded, the pipeline stops processing and returns partial results with PARTIAL_SUCCESS status. Timeout errors are recorded in ConversionResult.errors with category=TIMEOUT and descriptive error messages. Use ConversionResult.has_timeout_errors() to detect timeouts. If None, no timeout is enforced. Recommended: 90-120 seconds for production systems.</p>

    </div>

</div>

<h4 id="docling.datamodel.pipeline_options.ThreadedPdfPipelineOptions.force_backend_text" class="doc doc-heading">
<code class="doc-symbol doc-symbol-heading doc-symbol-attribute"></code>            <span class="doc doc-object-name doc-attribute-name">force_backend_text</span>


  <span class="doc doc-labels">
      <small class="doc doc-label doc-label-pydantic-field"><code>pydantic-field</code></small>
  </span>

</h4>
<div class="doc-signature highlight"><pre><span></span><code><span class="n">force_backend_text</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n"><span title="bool">bool</span></span>
</code></pre></div>

    <div class="doc doc-contents ">

        <p>Force use of PDF backend's native text extraction instead of layout model predictions. When enabled, bypasses the layout model's text detection and uses the embedded text from the PDF file directly. Useful for PDFs with reliable programmatic text layers.</p>

<h4 id="docling.datamodel.pipeline_options.VideoPipelineOptions.document_timeout" class="doc doc-heading">
<code class="doc-symbol doc-symbol-heading doc-symbol-attribute"></code>            <span class="doc doc-object-name doc-attribute-name">document_timeout</span>


  <span class="doc doc-labels">
      <small class="doc doc-label doc-label-pydantic-field"><code>pydantic-field</code></small>
  </span>

</h4>
<div class="doc-signature highlight"><pre><span></span><code><span class="n">document_timeout</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n"><span title="float">float</span></span> <span class="o">|</span> <span class="kc">None</span>
</code></pre></div>

    <div class="doc doc-contents ">

        <p>Maximum processing time in seconds before aborting document conversion. When exceeded, the pipeline stops processing and returns partial results with PARTIAL_SUCCESS status. Timeout errors are recorded in ConversionResult.errors with category=TIMEOUT and descriptive error messages. Use ConversionResult.has_timeout_errors() to detect timeouts. If None, no timeout is enforced. Recommended: 90-120 seconds for production systems.</p>

    </div>

</div>

<code class="doc-symbol doc-symbol-heading doc-symbol-class"></code>            <span class="doc doc-object-name doc-class-name">VlmExtractionPipelineOptions</span>

    <div class="doc doc-contents ">
            <p class="doc doc-class-bases">
              Bases: <code><a class="autorefs autorefs-internal" title="&lt;code class=&quot;doc-symbol doc-symbol-heading doc-symbol-class&quot;&gt;&lt;/code&gt;            &lt;span class=&quot;doc doc-object-name doc-class-name&quot;&gt;PipelineOptions&lt;/span&gt;


  &lt;span class=&quot;doc doc-labels&quot;&gt;
      &lt;small class=&quot;doc doc-label doc-label-pydantic-model&quot;&gt;&lt;code&gt;pydantic-model&lt;/code&gt;&lt;/small&gt;
  &lt;/span&gt;" href="./#docling.datamodel.pipeline_options.PipelineOptions">PipelineOptions</a></code></p>

        <p>Options for VLM-based structured information extraction pipeline.</p>
<p>Configures a pipeline that uses a vision-language model (default:
NuExtract-2B) to extract structured data fields from document images.
Unlike <code>VlmPipelineOptions</code> which converts pages to document format,
this pipeline targets extraction of specific entities or key-value pairs.</p>


<details class="supported-models" open>
  <summary>Supported models</summary>
  <ul>
<li><code>NU_EXTRACT_2B_TRANSFORMERS</code> (default) with <code>ExtractionPromptStyle.NUEXTRACT</code></li>
<li><code>GRANITE_VISION_4_1_TRANSFORMERS</code> with <code>ExtractionPromptStyle.GRANITE_VISION</code></li>
</ul>
</details>

<h4 id="docling.datamodel.pipeline_options.VlmExtractionPipelineOptions.accelerator_options" class="doc doc-heading">
<code class="doc-symbol doc-symbol-heading doc-symbol-attribute"></code>            <span class="doc doc-object-name doc-attribute-name">accelerator_options</span>


  <span class="doc doc-labels">
      <small class="doc doc-label doc-label-pydantic-field"><code>pydantic-field</code></small>
  </span>

</h4>
<div class="doc-signature highlight"><pre><span></span><code><span class="n">accelerator_options</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n"><span title="docling.datamodel.accelerator_options.AcceleratorOptions">AcceleratorOptions</span></span>
</code></pre></div>

    <div class="doc doc-contents ">

        <p>Hardware acceleration configuration for model inference. Controls GPU device selection, memory management, and execution optimization settings for layout, OCR, and table structure models.</p>

    </div>

</div>

<div class="doc doc-object doc-attribute">



<h4 id="docling.datamodel.pipeline_options.VlmExtractionPipelineOptions.allow_external_plugins" class="doc doc-heading">
<code class="doc-symbol doc-symbol-heading doc-symbol-attribute"></code>            <span class="doc doc-object-name doc-attribute-name">allow_external_plugins</span>


  <span class="doc doc-labels">
      <small class="doc doc-label doc-label-pydantic-field"><code>pydantic-field</code></small>
  </span>

</h4>
<div class="doc-signature highlight"><pre><span></span><code><span class="n">allow_external_plugins</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n"><span title="bool">bool</span></span>
</code></pre></div>

    <div class="doc doc-contents ">

        <p>Allow loading external third-party plugins for OCR, layout, table structure, or picture description models. Enables custom model implementations via plugin system. Disabled by default for security.</p>

    </div>

</div>

<div class="doc doc-object doc-attribute">



<h4 id="docling.datamodel.pipeline_options.VlmExtractionPipelineOptions.artifacts_path" class="doc doc-heading">
<code class="doc-symbol doc-symbol-heading doc-symbol-attribute"></code>            <span class="doc doc-object-name doc-attribute-name">artifacts_path</span>


  <span class="doc doc-labels">
      <small class="doc doc-label doc-label-pydantic-field"><code>pydantic-field</code></small>
  </span>

</h4>
<div class="doc-signature highlight"><pre><span></span><code><span class="n">artifacts_path</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n"><span title="pathlib.Path">Path</span></span> <span class="o">|</span> <span class="n"><span title="str">str</span></span> <span class="o">|</span> <span class="kc">None</span>
</code></pre></div>

    <div class="doc doc-contents ">

        <p>Local directory containing pre-downloaded model artifacts (weights, configs). If None, models are fetched from remote sources on first use. Use <code>docling-tools models download</code> to pre-fetch artifacts for offline operation or faster initialization.</p>

    </div>

</div>

<div class="doc doc-object doc-attribute">



<h4 id="docling.datamodel.pipeline_options.VlmExtractionPipelineOptions.document_timeout" class="doc doc-heading">
<code class="doc-symbol doc-symbol-heading doc-symbol-attribute"></code>            <span class="doc doc-object-name doc-attribute-name">document_timeout</span>


  <span class="doc doc-labels">
      <small class="doc doc-label doc-label-pydantic-field"><code>pydantic-field</code></small>
  </span>

</h4>
<div class="doc-signature highlight"><pre><span></span><code><span class="n">document_timeout</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n"><span title="float">float</span></span> <span class="o">|</span> <span class="kc">None</span>
</code></pre></div>

    <div class="doc doc-contents ">

        <p>Maximum processing time in seconds before aborting document conversion. When exceeded, the pipeline stops processing and returns partial results with PARTIAL_SUCCESS status. Timeout errors are recorded in ConversionResult.errors with category=TIMEOUT and descriptive error messages. Use ConversionResult.has_timeout_errors() to detect timeouts. If None, no timeout is enforced. Recommended: 90-120 seconds for production systems.</p>

    </div>

</div>

<div class="doc doc-object doc-attribute">

</code></pre></div>

    <div class="doc doc-contents ">

        <p>Allow pipeline to call external APIs or cloud services during processing. Required for API-based picture description models. Disabled by default for security and offline operation.</p>

    </div>

</div>

            <p class="doc doc-class-bases">
              Bases: <code><a class="autorefs autorefs-internal" title="&lt;code class=&quot;doc-symbol doc-symbol-heading doc-symbol-class&quot;&gt;&lt;/code&gt;            &lt;span class=&quot;doc doc-object-name doc-class-name&quot;&gt;PaginatedPipelineOptions&lt;/span&gt;


  &lt;span class=&quot;doc doc-labels&quot;&gt;
      &lt;small class=&quot;doc doc-label doc-label-pydantic-model&quot;&gt;&lt;code&gt;pydantic-model&lt;/code&gt;&lt;/small&gt;
  &lt;/span&gt;" href="./#docling.datamodel.pipeline_options.PaginatedPipelineOptions">PaginatedPipelineOptions</a></code></p>

        <p>Pipeline configuration for vision-language model based document processing.</p>
<p>Uses a VLM to understand document pages holistically from rendered page
images rather than composing results from separate layout, OCR, and
table-structure models. Page image generation is enabled by default
since the VLM requires visual input.</p>


<details class="notes" open>
  <summary>Notes</summary>
  <p>Unlike <code>PdfPipelineOptions</code>, this pipeline does not run separate
layout analysis or OCR stages. Set <code>force_backend_text=True</code> to
use the PDF backend's native text instead of VLM-predicted text.</p>
</details>

<div class="doc doc-object doc-attribute">



<h4 id="docling.datamodel.pipeline_options.VlmPipelineOptions.document_timeout" class="doc doc-heading">
<code class="doc-symbol doc-symbol-heading doc-symbol-attribute"></code>            <span class="doc doc-object-name doc-attribute-name">document_timeout</span>


  <span class="doc doc-labels">
      <small class="doc doc-label doc-label-pydantic-field"><code>pydantic-field</code></small>
  </span>

</h4>
<div class="doc-signature highlight"><pre><span></span><code><span class="n">document_timeout</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n"><span title="float">float</span></span> <span class="o">|</span> <span class="kc">None</span>
</code></pre></div>

    <div class="doc doc-contents ">

        <p>Maximum processing time in seconds before aborting document conversion. When exceeded, the pipeline stops processing and returns partial results with PARTIAL_SUCCESS status. Timeout errors are recorded in ConversionResult.errors with category=TIMEOUT and descriptive error messages. Use ConversionResult.has_timeout_errors() to detect timeouts. If None, no timeout is enforced. Recommended: 90-120 seconds for production systems.</p>

    </div>

</div>

</h4>
<div class="doc-signature highlight"><pre><span></span><code><span class="n">images_scale</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n"><span title="float">float</span></span>
</code></pre></div>

    <div class="doc doc-contents ">

        <p>Scaling factor for generated images. Higher values produce higher resolution but increase processing time and storage requirements. Recommended values: 1.0 (standard quality), 2.0 (high resolution), 0.5 (lower resolution for previews).</p>
